name: Volkswagen AG
research_rationale: Fresh news reinforces China and competition headwinds, and negative TTM FCF plus Q3 2026 losses in Yahoo data weaken the screen buy case despite FY2025 Automotive net cash flow of €6.4bn.

weekly_updates.summary:
Mid-November news (Yahoo) stresses weaker China deliveries and stronger local EV competition, including self-driving programme delays at a major supplier.
Screening data still shows TTM consolidated free cash flow of about −€7.5bn and a Q3 2026 quarterly operating loss in the Yahoo feed.
On-file FY2025 annual and January–September 2025 interim disclosures are unchanged in this refresh; filing bodies were re-synced only.
